title: 똑딱 소리 내기
instruction: 혀끝을 윗니 뒤쪽에 붙였다 떼며 똑딱 소리를 내보세요.
caption: 혀끝을 붙였다 떼며 똑딱 소리를 내보세요.
motion_prompt: Demonstrate a gentle clock-like tongue click: lift the tongue tip to the alveolar ridge behind the upper front teeth, create contact, release cleanly, and return to neutral in an even rhythm.
face_animation_policy: 중립·목표·복귀의 얼굴 전체 자세를 먼저 설계한다. 운동에 필요한 턱·볼·입꼬리·턱선을 함께 연동하고 선화·명암·질감을 맞춘다. 정지 얼굴 위에 입 도형만 교체하는 방식은 사용하지 않는다. 혀 독립 운동의 턱 안정은 해당 운동 의도를 따른다.
poses: tongue tip resting low behind lower front teeth
tongue TIP gently touching alveolar ridge just behind UPPER FRONT TEETH; anterior tongue raised while posterior tongue relaxed
tongue tip just RELEASED from upper ridge and lowered, contact clearly absent
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Animation keyframe atlas for tongue_13_clock_click. EXACTLY 1 columns and 3 rows of equal rectangular 16:9 tiles, edge-to-edge, NO gaps, NO borders, NO labels. Overall aspect ratio 16:27. Read tiles row-major left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each tile contains ONE complete scene, not multiple views. Create a clean non-graphic clinical educational 2D illustration matching the warm cel-shaded palette of the reference. Neutral pale warm background, large isolated mouth anatomy, no extra therapist portrait or inset. Keep the exact SAME oral geometry, camera and scale across all tiles. Distinguish ivory teeth, pink gingiva and hard/soft palate, single pink muscular tongue. Clear natural contact surfaces, no intersection through teeth or roof. No gore, saliva or surgery. This is an illustrative draft for professional review. Stable SIDE SAGITTAL mouth cutaway facing VIEWER-LEFT: lips/front teeth at left, throat at right; upper/lower jaw, alveolar ridge, hard palate and posterior soft palate visible. Do not show a frontal view. Tile poses: TILE 1: tongue tip resting low behind lower front teeth. TILE 2: tongue TIP gently touching alveolar ridge just behind UPPER FRONT TEETH; anterior tongue raised while posterior tongue relaxed. TILE 3: tongue tip just RELEASED from upper ridge and lowered, contact clearly absent. Crucial: each pose must differ by the REQUESTED movement, not random expression. One tongue only, no extra teeth, no detached lips, no camera cuts, no text, numbers, arrows, captions, logos, watermark or UI.
